title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled among sunken brass astrolabes and swaying twilight kelp, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days briskly sorting colorful sea glass into intricate, ever-changing mosaics. Whenever a visitor leans close, it pauses its rhythmic clattering to ripple with warm, bioluminescent patterns of sheer curiosity.
